title: Fix Opus 4.5/4.6 + Haiku 4.5 pricing; extract pricing table to JSON
description: ANTHROPIC_MODEL_PRICING uses Opus 4.0 rates ($15/$75) for all Opus 4.x, ~2.7x too high for Opus 4.5+. Correct: Opus 4.5 $5/$25, Opus 4.6 $5.5/$27.5, Haiku 4.5 $1.1/$5.5. Add specific patterns before generic fallbacks. Extract the whole pricing table to a bundled src/pricing.json (copied to dist/ during build) for maintainability/centralisation, with optional user overrides via config.display.pricingOverrides.
close_reason: Fixed Opus 4.5 ($5/$25), Opus 4.6 ($5.5/$27.5), Haiku 4.5 ($1.1/$5.5); extracted pricing to bundled src/pricing.json (copied to dist/ in build) with config.display.pricingOverrides.

title: Allow estimated cost for Bedrock/Vertex cloud providers
description: Token-based estimateSessionCost() currently returns null for Bedrock/Vertex even though per-token pricing is identical to direct Anthropic API. Remove the cloud-provider guard from estimateSessionCost() (keep it in getNativeCostUsd()). Estimate is already labelled distinctly (Est. Cost). Add display.showCostForCloudProviders (default true) to opt out. Enhancement: fall back to stdin context current_usage.input_tokens when transcript input tokens are 0 (proxy case).
close_reason: estimateSessionCost no longer suppressed for Bedrock/Vertex; native still suppressed. Added display.showCostForCloudProviders (default true) + input_tokens stdin fallback.

title: Optional provider name before model name
description: Add an opt-in config (display.showProvider, default false) to show the provider/custom-provider label BEFORE the model name on the project line. Users on custom proxies (same model names across providers) need to see which provider is active. Add display.providerName string override for custom providers; fall back to auto-detected getProviderLabel (Bedrock/Vertex/Enterprise). Default-off preserves current behavior.
close_reason: Added display.showProvider (default false) + display.providerName; provider leads the model when enabled, legacy trailing label preserved when off.

title: Per-process memory display (deferred / design)
description: DEFERRED per maintainer decision. Show top memory-consuming processes in addition to system RAM. Performance-sensitive: statusline runs every ~300ms, so spawning ps/parsing must be throttled and cached across invocations. Design separately before implementing.
